lock_scope: Definitions, quality gates and image diagnostics fixed before Phase2B acquisition; pilot already exploratory.

events.control_onset: First resolved downward actuation motion of an identified control. Mere finger contact/indicator light is insufficient. Electrical command time unknown without logs.
events.mechanism_first_visible_motion: First resolved change of the collector moving element from its preceding stationary orientation. Secondary motion is not initial onset; cut-occluded onset remains NA.
events.collector_ball_first_visible: First yellow ball surface visible below the mixing-chamber rim within collector housing, after a preceding frame with no visible ball there. This is a visibility event; hidden entry plane remains unknown.
events.permanent_isolation: Ball crosses a verified irreversible separation plane, with closure topology established. Otherwise NA; lower pocket presence is a separate proxy.
events.trough_entry_visible_proxy: First visible leading ball edge outside the collector mouth onto downstream ramp/result channel. Bounds widen for blur/cuts. This is downstream transport, not selection time.
events.overlay_number_first_clearly_readable: First legible new graphic number, including animation before slot placement. Separately record slot-filled time and unreviewed audio announcement as NA.

sampling.time_source: native source PTS; no frame/30 conversion

motion.physical_absolute_angle: NA until unique material marker + calibration + independent alias bound
motion.physical_rpm: NA until same-identity rotation confirmed and cross-checked
motion.camera_gate: Apply identical pixel parameters only to equivalent view; record camera geometry differences and refuse transfer otherwise. No silent ROI recentering.
motion.missing_coefficients: Refuse spectrum/autocorrelation across missing sectors; do not interpolate frames or signals.

uncertainty: Bracket width in encoded PTS/frame intervals is localization resolution, not empirical accuracy or camera time uncertainty. Held frames, exposure, occlusion and reviewer uncertainty remain separate.
statistics: Independent unit is draw, never seven balls as seven draws. Main captures and special transition separate. H2 may have descriptive visible transport cadence only. No p-value/CI for missing physical events or posthoc pattern selection.
stop_rule: One locked analysis per comparable camera segment; reject missingness/marker/alias gates rather than tuning to agreement. Limit replication to the four specified draws. Stop simulation calibration if geometry, physical RPM, gate state, ball IDs/depth/material parameters remain unidentified.
